_doc: Analyst judgments that persist across weekly scans. 'markets' is keyed by the 'key' field in data/latest.json (e.g. 'polymarket:12345', 'kalshi:KXTICKER-26DEC31'): direction (+1 YES is good for the stock or sector ETF, -1 bad), impact_pct (move if YES fully resolves, e.g. 0.06), ticker (override the linked ticker), category (override classification), ignore (true drops the market), verdict (actionable | watch | priced-in | noise | mapping-error), thesis (1-3 sentences), updated (YYYY-MM-DD). by_ticker ({TICKER: {direction, impact_pct}}) sets different values per linked company, e.g. merger target vs acquirer; impact_pct 0 is respected. Market-level direction/impact also apply when the market is netted into a theme. 'themes' is keyed by theme id from themes.json: impact_pct (default for its markets), verdict, thesis, ignore, updated. 'tickers': implied_vol (annualized options-implied vol, e.g. 0.55, replaces realized vol for price bets), next_earnings (YYYY-MM-DD), note.

crypto_policy.thesis: Market-structure bill by mid-2027 at 5% (-5 pts); implied -0.3% for BITQ. BITQ fell 20% this week with crypto prices (BTC dip-to-$55K odds +22 pts), not legislation. Revisit if a Senate vote is scheduled.

defense.thesis: Ukraine ceasefire (-9 pts to 8.5%) and peace-referendum (-6 pts) odds fell, mildly supportive for defense; netted they imply +0.4% for ITA, which lagged SPY by 0.7%. Gap under 1%; ITA is up 5.5% vs SPY in 30 days, so the longer move is in.

oil_supply.thesis: Oil-shock odds fell (WTI $90 in November -46 pts; Hormuz transit legs -22/-23 pts) and XLE already dropped 4.3% vs the market against -3.8% implied. Priced in.

ai_rules.thesis: Federal AI-safety bill before 2027 slipped 5 pts to 6%; implied effect on AIQ is ~0.1%, swamped by the AI-stock selloff.

polymarket:6941726.thesis: NVDA closed $125.53 after a 14% drop on Nov 20. A $120 intraday low needs -4.4% in the ~4.5 sessions left (Thanksgiving week): about 59% on realized vol vs a 43c ask, a 15-pt edge. Below the 20-pt bar for short-dated trades, and only ~$6.7K has traded, so the price may not be reliable.
